policy: Build each changed implementation successfully, then require exit 1 with FD_CHECK identifying a failed semantic assertion. A compiler error, sanitizer-only failure, signal, timeout, or surviving mutation is not an accepted rejection.

mutations.defect: Classify unsequenced modifications as unspecified order.
mutations.witness: Assessor-only exact verdict for i++ + i++.

mutations.defect: Compute a wrapped sum/product and inspect the result afterwards.
mutations.witness: offset=SIZE_MAX, count=1, width=1, limit=SIZE_MAX must fail and preserve output.

mutations.defect: Consume the remaining range when an oversized extraction fails.
mutations.witness: Seven-byte array, position=1, count=SIZE_MAX must preserve position and output.

mutations.defect: Erase the wire sign bit before decoding.
mutations.witness: Wire ffffffff denotes -1, and 80000000 denotes INT32_MIN.

mutations.defect: Leave allocated storage acquired after initializer failure.
mutations.witness: Nonzero initializer result must restore empty and exactly one free without destruction.

mutations.defect: Always copy forward, destroying unread source bytes when moving right.
mutations.witness: Snapshot oracle over every admitted source/destination/count window in a 12-byte array.

mutations.defect: Wrap generation 3 to 1 instead of permanently retiring the slot.
mutations.witness: Nine acquire/release histories require distinct slot/generation identities and eventual exhaustion.

mutations.defect: Publish the arithmetic result before checking trusted authority.
mutations.witness: Denied synthetic record count=2,value=3 must leave counter=10 instead of 16.
